programs.name: Travelers Summer Research Fellowship (T-SRF)
programs.focus: Seven weeks of lab or clinical research for pre-medical students, with medical-school preparation alongside it. Roughly 25 students taken per summer.
programs.stipend_note: Expenses covered and students housed on campus

eligibility.notes: Must be at least a junior at the time of application and a declared pre-medical student. The program targets students from underserved racial and ethnic groups or socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds, and looks for demonstrated engagement with underserved communities. Check whether you are eligible before spending time on it.

programs.notes: One of the few genuinely pre-med-oriented programs here rather than a PhD-pipeline one, and it covers expenses and housing. Eligibility is specific, so read it first. Second Weill Cornell route alongside the pediatrics internship already on the list. The linked page is the medical education programs index, T-SRF is listed there.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.focus: Biomedical research at NYU Langone with PhD-pipeline mentoring.

eligibility.notes: You need at least one full semester of bench lab research.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, due Feb 2, 2027 at 5 p.m. ET. About 30 students a summer.
programs.stipend_note: $5,000 plus free housing and round-trip travel; you pay for food

programs.name: Summer Research Early Identification Program (SR-EIP)
programs.city: Multiple member institutions (Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Harvard, Hopkins, Yale, Vanderbilt and more)
programs.focus: One application, many elite host institutions, plus a national research symposium at the end of the summer.
programs.stipend_note: Stipend plus travel and housing from the host institution

eligibility.notes: For students committed to a PhD or MD-PhD; the program says it is not designed for clinical medicine careers. At least two semesters done and one left when summer starts.

programs.notes: The portal is open now. One application ranks three of the 20 host sites, 8 to 10 weeks depending on the site. Howard University in Washington is the only host you could commute to. Johns Hopkins is not a 2027 host.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF), Biomedical Research
programs.focus: Ten weeks of mentored biomedical research at Mayo Clinic with a strong professional-development core.

eligibility.notes: Must have completed sophomore year by program start.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the window runs Nov 1, 2026 to Feb 3, 2027. You pick a research area when you apply, and neuroscience is one. About 180 undergraduates a year across three campuses; the Arizona and Florida tracks have their own pages.

programs.name: Summer Research Internships (Office of Trainee Affairs)
programs.org: Nationwide Children's Hospital / Abigail Wexner Research Institute
programs.focus: Several pediatric research tracks including cardiovascular research and REaCH-LABS (child health equity and outcomes).
programs.notes: Hub page lists several distinct tracks. A third-party guide put the cardiovascular portal at mid-October 2026 to Feb 7, 2027. Verify on the official page.

programs.name: Summer Biomedical Research Program (SBRP)
programs.org: East Carolina University: Brody School of Medicine
programs.focus: Basic science research at the Brody School of Medicine and ECU Health, with lab safety training and career workshops.

eligibility.notes: Undergraduates. An older ECU document describes the program as targeting students from underrepresented, low-socioeconomic or rural backgrounds. Confirm current rules on the page.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 cycle is open now and closes Feb 12, 2027. The program runs May 24 - Jul 23, 2027. The page posts no stipend or housing, so ask before you count on either.

programs.name: AHA Undergraduate Summer Fellowship (AHA-USF)
programs.focus: American Heart Association-funded cardiovascular and stroke research in a basic science lab, with no clinical shadowing.
programs.notes: Opens Dec 1, 2026. Everything, your letter and transcript included, must arrive by NOON Eastern on Feb 15, 2027, not end of day. Up to 6 students. You are a Penn State student, so you apply as an internal candidate. Same campus as SURIP and PROMISE.
programs.stipend_note: $6,000 before taxes; housing in Hershey is yours to pay

programs.name: REU Sites: Biological Sciences (search portal)
programs.focus: The master index of NSF-funded Research Experiences for Undergraduates. Each site applies separately; stipends are standardized and housing is usually covered.
programs.stipend_note: Typically $6,000-$7,000 plus housing and travel

eligibility.notes: NSF REUs require US citizenship or permanent residency. Most exclude graduating seniors.

programs.notes: Not one program but a portal to hundreds. Filter by Biological Sciences and by state. Deadlines run from December to March, so check it monthly. Housing and travel are usually covered, which makes REUs cheaper than many hospital programs.

programs.name: Summer Research Internship
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research.

programs.name: Summer Research Internship
programs.org: Rady Children's Hospital / UC San Diego
programs.focus: Pediatric genomics and translational research, including the Rady Children's Institute for Genomic Medicine.
programs.notes: A rare pediatric genomics angle, if that interests you.

programs.name: Summer Research Internship
programs.focus: Neurodevelopmental disorders research: autism, fragile X, ADHD.
programs.notes: One of the best neurodevelopmental research centers in the country. A direct lab email works better than a central application here.

programs.name: Summer Research Program
programs.org: Stanley Manne Children's Research Institute (Lurie Children's)
programs.focus: Pediatric research affiliated with Northwestern Feinberg School of Medicine.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF)
programs.focus: Ten weeks on a project the student proposes themselves, written up as a formal proposal with a mentor and presented at a seminar day.

eligibility.notes: Open to students from any school. Full time and in person for all ten weeks.

programs.notes: Different from every other program here: the applicant writes a research PROPOSAL with a prospective mentor rather than just an essay. That means contacting a mentor early is not optional; it is the application. Budget far more time than a standard app, but the proposal itself is excellent practice for graduate fellowships later.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Ten-week structured biomedical research experience through the Morningside Graduate School.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opens Dec 1, 2026 and closes Mar 1, 2027, later than most of your list.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.
programs.stipend_note: $6,000 plus all travel and housing

programs.name: Alzheimer's Disease Research Center summer research
programs.focus: Alzheimer's disease clinical and imaging research at a major NIA-funded center.
programs.notes: If the INSPIRE Alzheimer's angle is the real interest, the national network of NIA-funded ADRCs is the thing to mine. There are more than 30, and most take undergrads by direct arrangement rather than a posted program.

programs.name: Biological Sciences Division: summer research
programs.focus: Biomedical research across the Biological Sciences Division, with Comer Children's Hospital for pediatric projects.
programs.notes: CORRECTED: the Pritzker Summer Research Program page, with its 30 Nov 2026 deadline, is for the University of Chicago's own MEDICAL students, not undergraduates. Do not chase that date. UChicago is a Leadership Alliance member institution, so the SR-EIP application is the reliable undergraduate route in; this hub is the place to look for a direct lab contact. Comer Children's is the pediatric angle.

programs.name: Children's Mercy Research Institute training
programs.focus: Pediatric research with notable strength in genomic medicine and precision therapeutics.
programs.notes: Pairs geographically with Stowers, also in Kansas City, two solid programs in a city almost nobody applies to from the coasts.

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics Summer Internship
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research with Weill Cornell pediatrics faculty.
programs.notes: The page still shows the 2026 cycle (opened Dec 8, 2025, due Jan 5, 2026), so treat Dec 8 as a guess. Seventeen pediatrics projects including child neurology neuroimaging and epilepsy; you can apply to two. No housing, food or travel.
programs.stipend_note: A modest stipend, amount not posted, paid when you finish

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics research (Le Bonheur)
programs.org: UT Health Science Center / Le Bonheur Children's Hospital
programs.focus: Pediatric research at Le Bonheur, including a well-regarded neuroscience and epilepsy group.
programs.notes: Same city as St. Jude. If you are applying to POE anyway, a direct email here costs nothing, and the pediatric epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's lab on your list. Likely arranged by direct contact rather than a portal.

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics research opportunities (Riley Children's)
programs.org: Indiana University School of Medicine / Riley Children's Health
programs.focus: Pediatric research across IU's Department of Pediatrics at Riley Children's.
programs.notes: The department page lists training only for physicians, residents and faculty, with no undergraduate program and no application. The only way in is emailing a faculty member whose work you like. INSPIRE and the Medical Neuroscience program above are the real Indiana applications.

programs.name: Duke Summer Research Opportunity Program (SROP)
programs.focus: Research placements across Duke including a well-regarded neuroscience track.
programs.stipend_note: Competitive stipend plus shared on-campus housing and travel help; no figure posted
programs.notes: The program was not held in 2026, and the page still says to check back in fall 2026 for summer 2027. Nothing is posted yet. Nine weeks of biomedical research, shared on-campus housing, travel help and a stipend, aimed at students considering a PhD.
programs.category: Academic medical centers & med school SURPs

programs.name: Education & training programs
programs.focus: Neurology and neurosurgery research at one of the largest dedicated neurological institutes in the world.
programs.notes: Strong clinical neuroscience exposure, which is harder to find than bench neuroscience. Pairs with Phoenix Children's for one city.

programs.name: Emergency Department Clinical Research Internship
programs.focus: Hands-on pediatric emergency medicine clinical research, patient enrollment and data collection in the ED.

eligibility.notes: Roughly 15 hours/week onsite during the fall-spring session.

programs.notes: The posted cycle is a FALL-SPRING internship (Sept 2026 to May 2027), not a summer program, and the page says nothing about summer. It is real pediatric emergency patient contact, which is rare, so email the program manager, Desiree Edemba, to ask whether a summer 2027 session runs. Do not plan your summer around it. About an hour from Leesburg.
programs.stipend_note: Unpaid; the page says a stipend may be available

programs.name: NIA Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers: directory
programs.focus: The master directory of NIA-funded Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers.
programs.notes: Not a program: a hunting ground. Pick the three centers nearest you and email the education coordinator at each. Most do not advertise undergraduate slots but will take a strong student who asks. The single highest-leverage move for an Alzheimer's interest.

programs.name: Neuroscience & Cell Biology Summer Research
programs.org: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School
programs.focus: Neuroscience and cell biology research in RWJMS labs.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Jan 2.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Pathways to Science: summer research database
programs.focus: The best free aggregator of funded undergraduate summer research programs, searchable by discipline and deadline.
programs.notes: Use this as a monthly sweep to catch programs this list does not have. Sort by deadline.

programs.name: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Internship (Loddenkemper Lab)
programs.focus: Pediatric epilepsy and EEG research in a single high-output lab.
programs.notes: Unpaid, 30 hours a week, with a remote option. Send questions only to LoddenkemperInternship@childrens.harvard.edu, not to lab members. The page still shows last cycle's dates, so check it from early January.
programs.stipend_note: Unpaid: you need academic credit from your school or outside funding

programs.name: Pediatrics summer research (Benioff Children's)
programs.focus: Pediatric research across UCSF's Department of Pediatrics.
programs.notes: The department page offers student programs for medical students only, with no undergraduate application. Placements like this come from emailing a faculty member directly; the Emailing a lab guide on this site walks you through it.

programs.name: Rebecca D. Considine Research Institute summer programs
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research at a mid-size children's hospital.
programs.notes: Genuine safety. Ohio now has five options on this list, Cincinnati, Nationwide, the two Case Western programs, Cleveland Clinic and this.

programs.name: Research & Innovation summer opportunities
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research, affiliated with UConn Health.
programs.notes: Close to Yale, so a New Haven / Hartford trip could cover both this and the Child Study Center. Smaller applicant pool than the big-name children's hospitals.

programs.name: Research Training & Internships
programs.focus: Multiple pediatric research internship tracks across the institute.
programs.notes: The page still shows the 2026 cycle (applications Dec 1, 2025 to Feb 1, 2026), so 2027 dates are not posted. You rank three mentors in the application. Email ResearchInternship@childrenscolorado.org to ask when 2027 opens.
programs.stipend_note: $4,400 in 2026, meant to cover travel and housing; no housing is provided

programs.name: Research and education programs
programs.focus: Northern Virginia's largest health system, with clinical and translational research including Inova Children's Hospital.
programs.notes: About 35 minutes from Leesburg, so no housing cost. You already worked in Fairfax at Privia, so you know the area and may have a contact who can point you at the right person. This is a hub page: the summer research listings sit under research and education, and a direct email is likely to work better than a portal.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Research opportunities
programs.org: George Washington University School of Medicine
programs.focus: Clinical and translational research in downtown DC, with ties to Children's National.
programs.notes: GW's pediatrics department is based at Children's National, so an email here can lead to the same place by another route.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Simmons Cancer Center education & training
programs.org: UT Southwestern Harold C. Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center
programs.focus: Cancer-focused summer research training at UT Southwestern.
programs.notes: Second UT Southwestern route alongside SURF, which is also an Amgen host, three paths into the same institution.

programs.name: Strong Children's Research Center Summer Training Program
programs.org: University of Rochester Medical Center, Department of Pediatrics
programs.focus: Ten weeks on a project with a pediatrics faculty mentor in the specialty you choose, ending in a poster session for the whole Department of Pediatrics. Running for the 37th year.
programs.stipend_note: $3,000 plus free on-campus housing; travel is yours

eligibility.notes: Entering junior or senior year when the program starts. US citizens, permanent residents, or international students able to work in the US.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 application opened Monday, Nov 16, 2026, and applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so earlier is better. It wants official transcripts that include your fall 2026 semester, so you can submit once fall grades post. Two faculty letters, a CV and short answers. You are placed with a mentor in the pediatric specialty you pick.

programs.name: Student Research Programs
programs.focus: Campus-level undergraduate research program listings.
programs.notes: The weakest entry on your list unless you have an ODU connection. This is a general campus page, not a competitive national program.

programs.name: Summer Research Program
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research, including a notable pediatric epilepsy and neurosciences group.
programs.notes: Their pediatric neurosciences/epilepsy work overlaps with the Boston Children's epilepsy interest, a good direct-email target.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Programs: searchable database
programs.focus: The AAMC's own index of summer research programs at US medical schools, searchable by state and institution.
programs.notes: Complements Pathways to Science rather than duplicating it: this one is specifically medical schools, which is exactly the right slice. Worth a monthly sweep alongside the NSF REU portal.

programs.name: Summer education programs
programs.focus: Cancer research at the oldest cancer center in the United States.
programs.notes: Markedly less contested than MSK or Dana-Farber while still being an NCI comprehensive cancer center.

programs.name: Summer research
programs.org: Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at Virginia Tech Carilion
programs.focus: Neuroscience-heavy institute with work on addiction, developmental neuroscience and human neuroimaging.
programs.notes: Not commutable from Leesburg, but a genuinely strong neuroscience institute in Virginia that very few people outside the state apply to. The human neuroimaging work is close to what you already do in the lab.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.focus: Medical school research across neuroscience and the Lombardi Comprehensive Cancer Center.
programs.notes: Roughly an hour from Leesburg. Lombardi is an NCI comprehensive cancer center, and the neuroscience department is strong. Hub page: look under education and training for the summer listings.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Summer research programs
programs.org: University of Virginia School of Medicine
programs.focus: Biomedical research at Virginia's flagship medical school, including UVA Children's.
programs.notes: About two hours from Leesburg, so a weekend drive home rather than a commute. In-state and a strong pediatrics department.
programs.category: Commutable from home (DC metro and Virginia)

programs.name: Undergraduate Scholars / student programs
programs.focus: Neuroscience and imaging research at HHMI's dedicated research campus, with an unusually strong tools-and-methods culture.

eligibility.notes: Open to undergraduates at partner institutions, so check whether Penn State is a partner before you spend time on this one.

programs.notes: In Ashburn, about 15 minutes from Leesburg. Summer undergraduates now come through HHMI's Cech Fellows Program, nine weeks, so check the Cech Fellows page for the deadline and stipend. The Janelia and Loudoun County internship listed beside it is for high school students. Small and very selective, and best if you lean computational or imaging.

programs.name: Undergraduate research fellowships
programs.focus: Regeneration, aging and comparative biology at a small marine and biomedical research institute.
programs.notes: Same town as the Jackson Laboratory, so one Bar Harbor application trip covers both, and this one is far less contested than JAX.
